source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center, Oceanic Niño Index (ONI), DJF season anomaly; https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/data/indices/oni.ascii.txt
phaseRule: El Niño when the DJF ONI is >= 0.5 °C, La Niña when <= -0.5 °C, otherwise neutral. Keyed by water year (the DJF season of Dec Y-1 to Feb Y belongs to water year Y, i.e. the Y-1/Y winter).
